introPanels.title: Before the empire
introPanels.narration: Our story begins on a South American riverbank. General Mandible has ambitious plans. The workers have lunch plans.
introPanels.fieldNote: Argentine ants are native to the Paraná drainage. At home, they are part of an ecosystem. Native-range presence is not an invasion.

introPanels.title: An unconventional fleet
introPanels.narration: A plant pot leaves the nursery. The General calls it a naval operation. Nobody asked the human carrying it.
introPanels.fieldNote: Human transport can move Argentine ants between distant places. Our pot journey is fictional, not a documented route from Paraná to California.

introPanels.title: The California briefing
introPanels.narration: Our fictional campaign opens near the Berkeley reference sample. One gateway, a few trails, and a very large ego.
introPanels.fieldNote: US1 is the Berkeley population sampled in 2008–2009. Your local nests, ownership, workers, and battles are game abstractions.

introPanels.title: An awkward family reunion
introPanels.narration: A familiar scent can open a trail. An unfamiliar colony can make that introduction considerably less friendly.
introPanels.fieldNote: The global study reported tolerance among some populations and aggression between others. Unknown comparisons remain unknown. The General does not run real ants.

vignettes.title: The plant-pot admiral
vignettes.narration: No ocean-going ant trail. No tiny engines. Just an enormous supply chain and some accidental passengers.
vignettes.fieldNote: Checking plants, soil, materials, and equipment before moving them helps prevent accidental spread. Follow local official guidance.

vignettes.title: Send the cavalry
vignettes.narration: The General orders a magnificent charge. The rock corridor admits a rather less magnificent number of workers at once.
vignettes.fieldNote: In the terrain experiments, meat ants won every tested arena; complex arenas reduced their fatalities. The game uses balanced values to illustrate participation limits.

vignettes.title: A very scented rebellion
vignettes.narration: Three banners. Three rival identities. The General sees a conspiracy. The field notebook sees several untested relationships.
vignettes.fieldNote: Distinct rival populations are not automatically allied. Game AI acts only on its allowed relationships; unreported research pairs are never labeled friendly or hostile.
